name: BlackRock Daily Reinvestment Stablecoin Reserve Vehicle
oneLiner: BRSRV is BlackRock's registered Treasury, repo and cash fund share, targeting $1 NAV with income reinvestment and Securitize redemption.
collateral: Cash, U.S. Treasury obligations with no more than 93 days to maturity, and Treasury-secured overnight repurchase agreements in BlackRock Daily Reinvestment Stablecoin Reserve Vehicle; BNY Mellon is custodian and accounting-services provider, Securitize is transfer agent. Current security-level weights are not established.
pegMechanism: Registered government money-market OnChain share targeting $1 NAV, with daily income reinvested in additional shares. Securitize administers whitelisted subscriptions, transfers and redemptions. Good-order redemption requests received before 5 p.m. Eastern on eligible business days ordinarily settle by same-day federal-funds wire when the custodian is open; the fund reserves up to seven days. Redemption processing remains available off-chain during blockchain outages. Sponsor support and principal preservation are not guaranteed.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact deployment represents a USD short-duration money-market fund share with ordinary NAV redemption. The tbill family models the fund/NAV mechanism; it does not imply Treasury-only holdings. This is a distinct registered fund, not BUIDL.

jurisdiction.license: Investment Company Act of 1940 registered government money market fund

yieldConfig.yieldSource: BlackRock Treasury, overnight repo and cash fund income reinvestment
